verses.geez: ወልድ፡ ማእምር፡ ሰማዔ፡ አብ፡ ይከውን፡ ወወልድሰ፡ ዘኢይሰምዕ፡ ይከውን፡ ለኀጒል።
verses.translation: A wise son is obedient to his father: but a disobedient son will be destroyed.

translations.lxx: A wise son is obedient to his father: but a disobedient son will be destroyed.
translations.kjv: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
translations.ron: Fiul înţelept ascultă de învăţătura tatălui său, iar cel batjocoritor nici de mustrare.

verses.geez: ወእምፍሬ፡ ጽድቁ፡ ይበልዕ፡ ኄር፡ ወነፍሰ፡ ዓማፅያንሰ፡ ይትኀጐል፡ ቆዖሙ።
verses.translation: A good man shall eat of the fruits of righteousness: but the lives of transgressors shall perish before their time.

translations.lxx: A good man shall eat of the fruits of righteousness: but the lives of transgressors shall perish before their time.
translations.kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
translations.ron: Din rodul gurii sale omul mănâncă binele; pofta celor vicleni este silnicia.

verses.geez: ዘየዓቅብ፡ አፉሁ፡ ይትመኀፀና፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ወጒጒእሰ፡ በከናፍሪሁ፡ ያወድቅ፡ ርእሶ።
verses.translation: He that keeps his own mouth keeps his own life: but he that is hasty with his lips shall bring terror upon himself.

translations.lxx: He that keeps his own mouth keeps his own life: but he that is hasty with his lips shall bring terror upon himself.
translations.kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
translations.ron: Cine îşi păzeşte gura îşi păzeşte sufletul său; cel ce deschide prea tare buzele o face spre pieirea lui.

verses.geez: ኵሉ፡ ዘኢይትቀነይ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍትወት፡ ሀሎ፡ ወእዴሆሙ፡ ለኄራን፡ ያስተሐምም።
verses.translation: Every slothful man desires, but the hands of the active are diligent.

translations.lxx: Every slothful man desires, but the hands of the active are diligent.
translations.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
translations.ron: Sufletul celui leneş pofteşte, însă în zadar. Numai sufletul celor silitori este îndestulat.

verses.geez: ቃለ፡ ዓማፂ፡ ይጸልእ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወረሲዕሰ፡ የኀፍር፡ ወኢይመጽእ፡ ገሃደ።
verses.translation: A righteous man hates an unjust word: but an ungodly man is ashamed, and will have no confidence.

translations.lxx: A righteous man hates an unjust word: but an ungodly man is ashamed, and will have no confidence.
translations.kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
translations.ron: Dreptul urăşte cuvintele mincinoase; ticălosul aduce numai ruşine şi ocară.

verses.geez: ጽድቅ፡ ተዓቅቦሙ፡ ለየዋሃን፡ በፍኖት፡ ለረሲዓንሰ፡ እቡሰ፡ ይሬስዮሙ፡ ኃጢአት።

translations.kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
translations.ron: Dreptatea păzeşte calea omului fără prihană, iar fărădelegea e pricina ruinii celui păcătos.

verses.geez: ቦ፡ እለ፡ ያሌዕሉ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ምንትኒ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ወቦ፡ እለ፡ ያቴሕቱ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ብዕሎሙ።
verses.translation: There are some who, having nothing, enrich themselves: and there are some who bring themselves down in the midst of much wealth.

translations.lxx: There are some who, having nothing, enrich themselves: and there are some who bring themselves down in the midst of much wealth.
translations.kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
translations.ron: Unii se dau drept bogaţi şi n-au nimic, alţii trec drept săraci, cu toate că au multe averi.

verses.geez: ቤዛ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ጥሪተ፡ ብዕሉ፡ ወነዳይሰ፡ ኢይትቃወም፡ መዓተ።
verses.translation: A man's own wealth is the ransom of his life: but the poor endures not threatening.

translations.lxx: A man's own wealth is the ransom of his life: but the poor endures not threatening.
translations.kjv: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
translations.ron: Bogăţia cuiva slujeşte la răscumpărarea lui; cel sărac nu se teme nici chiar de ameninţare.

verses.geez: ብርሃን፡ ለጻድቃን፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወብርሃነ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ትጠፍእ።
verses.translation: The righteous always have light: but the light of the ungodly is quenched.

translations.lxx: Crafty souls go astray in sins: but just men pity, and are merciful.
translations.kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
translations.ron: Lumina celor drepţi luminează, pe când sfeşnicul celor fără de lege se stinge.

verses.geez: ነፍሳተ፡ ሕቡላን፡ ይስሕታ፡ በኃጢአት፡ ወጻድቃንሰ፡ ይምሕሩ፡ ወይመጸውቱ።
verses.translation: A bad man does evil with insolence: but they that are judges of themselves are wise.

translations.lxx: A bad man does evil with insolence: but they that are judges of themselves are wise.
translations.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
translations.ron: Mândria nu dă prilej decât la ceartă, înţelepciunea se află numai la cei ce primesc sfaturi.

verses.geez: እኩይ፡ ዘምስለ፡ ጽእለቱ፡ ይገብር፡ እኩየ፡ ወእለሰ፡ የአምሩ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ጠቢባን፡ እሙንቱ።
verses.translation: Wealth gotten hastily with iniquity is diminished: but he that gathers for himself with godliness shall be increased. The righteous is merciful, and lends.

translations.lxx: Wealth gotten hastily with iniquity is diminished: but he that gathers for himself with godliness shall be increased. The righteous is merciful, and lends.
translations.kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
translations.ron: Bogăţia adunată în grabă se împuţinează, numai cel ce-o adună pe încetul o înmulţeşte.

verses.geez: አጥርዮ፡ ዘይጐጒእ፡ በኃጢአት፡ ውኁደ፡ ይከውን፡ በደኃሪቱ፡ ወዘሰ፡ ያሥተጋብእ፡ ለርእሱ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ይፈደፍድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ጻድቅኒ፡ ይምሕር፡ ወይሌቅሕ።
verses.translation: Better is he that begins to help heartily, than he that promises and leads another to hope: for a good desire is a tree of life.

translations.lxx: Better is he that begins to help heartily, than he that promises and leads another to hope: for a good desire is a tree of life.
translations.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
translations.ron: Aşteptarea prea îndelungată îmbolnăveşte inima, iar dorinţa împlinită este pom al vieţii.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ዘይዌጥን፡ ይርዳእ፡ ነፍሶ፡ እምነ፡ ዘይብዕል፡ ወያጸንዕ፡ ለተስፋ።
verses.translation: He that slights a matter shall be slighted of it: but he that fears the commandment has health of soul.

translations.lxx: To a crafty son there shall be nothing good: but a wise servant shall have prosperous doings, and his way shall be directed aright.
translations.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
translations.ron: Cel ce nu ia în seamă cuvântul (lui Dumnezeu) este dat pierzării, iar cel ce se teme de porunca Lui este răsplătit.

verses.geez: ዕፅ፡ ሕይወት፡ ይእቲ፡ ፍኖት፡ ሠናይት።
verses.translation: The law of the wise is a fountain of life: but the man void of understanding shall die by a snare.

translations.lxx: The law of the wise is a fountain of life: but the man void of understanding shall die by a snare.
translations.kjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
translations.ron: Învăţătura celui înţelept este izvor de viaţă, ca să putem scăpa de cursele morţii.

verses.geez: ዘያሰትት፡ ግብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱኒ፡ ያሰትቶ፡ ወዘሰ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ትእዛዞ፡ የሐዩ፡ ቦቱ።
verses.translation: Sound discretion gives favour, and to know the law is the part of a sound understanding: but the ways of scorners tend to destruction.

translations.lxx: Sound discretion gives favour, and to know the law is the part of a sound understanding: but the ways of scorners tend to destruction.
translations.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
translations.ron: Buna înţelegere rodeşte har; calea celor vicleni este spre pieirea lor.

verses.geez: ለወልድ፡ ሕቡል፡ አልቦቱ፡ ምንትኒ፡ ሠናይ፡ ለገብርሰ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ሠናየ፡ ይከውን፡ ምግባሩ፡ ወይረትዕ፡ ፍኖቱ።
verses.translation: Every prudent man acts with knowledge: but the fool displays his own mischief.

translations.lxx: Every prudent man acts with knowledge: but the fool displays his own mischief.
translations.kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
translations.ron: Orice om înţelept lucrează cu chibzuinţă, numai cel nebun îşi desfăşoară nebunia.

verses.geez: ሕገ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ነቅዐ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወዘእንበለ፡ ልብሰ፡ በአበሳ፡ ይመውት።
verses.translation: A rash king shall fall into mischief: but a wise messenger shall deliver him.

translations.lxx: A rash king shall fall into mischief: but a wise messenger shall deliver him.
translations.kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
translations.ron: Un sol ticălos cade în nenorocire, iar unul credincios aduce alinare.

verses.geez: አእምሮ፡ ሠናይ፡ ይሁብ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወሞገሰ፡ ወፍናዊሆሙሰ፡ ለኀዩያን፡ ውስተ፡ ኀጒል።
verses.translation: Instruction removes poverty and disgrace: but he that attends to reproofs shall be honoured.

translations.lxx: Instruction removes poverty and disgrace: but he that attends to reproofs shall be honoured.
translations.kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
translations.ron: De sărăcie şi de ruşine are parte cel ce nesocoteşte certarea, iar cel ce primeşte mustrarea va fi cinstit.

verses.geez: ኵሉ፡ ማእምር፡ ይገብር፡ በምክር፡ ወዐብድሰ፡ አሥረረ፡ እከየ፡ ዚአሁ።
verses.translation: The desires of the godly gladden the soul, but the works of the ungodly are far from knowledge.

translations.lxx: The desires of the godly gladden the soul, but the works of the ungodly are far from knowledge.
translations.kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
translations.ron: Dorinţa împlinită mulţumeşte sufletul, iar depărtarea de rău este urâciune pentru cei nebuni.

verses.geez: ላእክ፡ ዐብድ፡ ይወድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ እኪት፡ ወሐዋርያሰ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ያድኅን፡ ርእሶ።
verses.translation: If thou walkest with wise men thou shalt be wise: but he that walks with fools shall be known.

translations.lxx: If thou walkest with wise men thou shalt be wise: but he that walks with fools shall be known.
translations.kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
translations.ron: Cel ce se însoţeşte cu cei înţelepţi ajunge înţelept, iar cel ce se întovărăşeşte cu cei nebuni se face rău.

verses.geez: ንዴተ፡ ወኃሣረ፡ ያሴስል፡ ትምህርት፡ ወዘየዓቅብሰ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ ይከብር።
verses.translation: Evil shall pursue sinners; but good shall overtake the righteous.

translations.lxx: Evil shall pursue sinners; but good shall overtake the righteous.
translations.kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
translations.ron: Nenorocirea urmăreşte pe cei păcătoşi, iar fericirea răsplăteşte pe cei drepţi.

verses.geez: ፍትወተ፡ ኄራን፡ ያጥዒ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ወምግባረ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ርኁቅ፡ እምአእምሮ።
verses.translation: A good man shall inherit children's children; and the wealth of ungodly men is laid up for the just.

translations.lxx: A good man shall inherit children's children; and the wealth of ungodly men is laid up for the just.
translations.kjv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
translations.ron: Omul bun lasă moştenirea sa nepoţilor săi, iar averea celui păcătos este sortită pentru cei drepţi.

verses.geez: ዘይደመር፡ ምስለ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ይከውን፡ ወዘሰ፡ ያንዘሃልል፡ ምስለ፡ ዓብዳን፡ ዐብደ፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: The righteous shall spend many years in wealth: but the unrighteous shall perish suddenly.

translations.lxx: The righteous shall spend many years in wealth: but the unrighteous shall perish suddenly.
translations.kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
translations.ron: Arătura în ţelină, făcută de cei săraci, dă hrană din belşug, însă averea se pierde din pricina nedreptăţii.

verses.geez: ለእለ፡ ይኤብሱ፡ ይዴግኖሙ፡ እኩይ፡ ወለጻድቃንሰ፡ ይረክቦሙ፡ ሠናይ።
verses.translation: He that spares the rod hates his son: but he that loves, carefully chastens him.

translations.lxx: He that spares the rod hates his son: but he that loves, carefully chastens him.
translations.kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
translations.ron: Cine cruţă toiagul său îşi urăşte copilul, iar cel care îl iubeşte îl ceartă la vreme.

verses.geez: ኄር፡ ብእሲ፡ ይሬኢ፡ ውሉደ፡ ውሉድ፡ ወይዘገብ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ብዕለ፡ ረሲዓን።
verses.translation: A just man eats and satisfies his soul: but the souls of the ungodly are in want.

translations.lxx: A just man eats and satisfies his soul: but the souls of the ungodly are in want.
translations.kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
translations.ron: Dreptul mănâncă şi îşi îndestulează sufletul său, iar pântecele celor fără de lege duce lipsă.

verses.geez: ጻድቃን፡ ይሄልዉ፡ በብዕል፡ ዓመታተ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወዓማፅያንሰ፡ ይትኀጐሉ፡ ፍጡነ።
ዘይምሀከ፡ በትሮ፡ ጸልአ፡ ወልዶ፡ ወዘያፈቅርሰ፡ ወልዶ፡ ወትረ፡ ይጌሥፅ።
ጻድቅሰ፡ እንዘ፡ ይበልዕ፡ ይመልእ፡ ነፍሶ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ፅኑስ።
